profile.name: Path Robotics
profile.summary: Columbus, Ohio company selling autonomous welding for high-mix industrial parts, as robots-as-a-service cells and as contract welding capacity through Path Foundry.
profile.assetType: Steel fabrication plants, shipyards and heavy-equipment factories with recurring manual welding
profile.buyerPersona: VP of Operations or Plant Manager responsible for welding throughput

icp.label: Industry
icp.value: US steel fabrication, shipbuilding, heavy equipment and defense manufacturing

icp.label: Production profile
icp.value: High-mix steel parts where fit-up varies from part to part

icp.label: Trigger
icp.value: Public plant expansion or a welder hiring push

icp.label: Buying model
icp.value: Prefers subscription or outsourced capacity to a capital purchase

expansion: Rove mobile autonomous welding for large structures

targets.name: Southland Steel Fabricators
targets.location: St. Helena Parish, Louisiana (Greensburg area, approx.)

reason.text: $25M expansion running through 2026 explicitly grows robotic welding, so the budget line and appetite already exist.
reason.quote: will increase robotic welding capacity by 50%

targets.pathNote: Southland already runs robotic welding, so Path would have to displace or sit alongside the current vendor, which is not publicly identified. No warm path is publicly sourced.

targets.name: Wisconsin Heavy Fabrication

reason.text: Hiring more than 100 people, welders included, at a former Broadwind site, which points to immediate capacity need.
reason.quote: Wisconsin Heavy Fabrication is expanding operations and hiring more than 100 employees at its Manitowoc facility.

targets.pathNote: Cold outreach to plant leadership. No public relationship with Path was found.

targets.name: Merrill Steel

reason.text: New greenfield plant with 108 jobs over three years, so the welding process may still be open to design.
reason.quote: The operation will create 108 new jobs over three years.

targets.pathNote: Cold outreach timed to the plant build-out. No public relationship with Path was found.

targets.name: Austal USA

reason.text: New final assembly facility for large steel modules, with more than 1,000 jobs planned. The source dates from 2024.
reason.quote: The facility is expected to create 1,032 jobs over the next four years

targets.pathNote: Cold outreach. Navy qualification requirements are likely to lengthen any sale.

targets.name: Fincantieri Marinette Marine

reason.text: About 400 workers added at Marinette in a 2025 hiring wave. The source does not mention welders specifically.
reason.quote: approximately 400 new employees at Fincantieri Marinette Marine in Wisconsin

targets.pathNote: Cold outreach. Naval welding qualification is an expected hurdle.

targets.name: JCB

reason.text: New plant doubled to 1 million sq ft with 1,500 expected jobs. Global production standards may limit local vendor choice.
reason.quote: It is expected to employ 1,500 people

targets.pathNote: Cold outreach. Manufacturing decisions may sit with the UK parent.

targets.name: Caterpillar

reason.text: New Sanford capacity for compact machines. The source gives no welding detail and no job count for the expansion.
reason.quote: increase production of compact track loaders and telehandlers

targets.pathNote: Cold outreach into a large enterprise with established automation suppliers, so expect a long cycle.

targets.name: Falcon Steel America
targets.pathNote: A search listing described a plant acquisition and hiring, but the page returned 403 and could not be opened or dated. No quotable evidence, so this target is held back.

targets.name: Oshkosh Defense

reason.text: Production layoffs point to excess labor rather than a welding capacity shortage.
reason.quote: Oshkosh Defense confirms it will lay off about 160 employees early next year.

targets.pathNote: No credible opening while the company is cutting production roles.
targets.disqualifier: Layoffs of about 160 production positions effective January 5, 2026

targets.name: Wabash National

reason.text: This plant, which employed welders, is closing, so there is no site to sell into.
reason.quote: plans to cease operations at the facility by this spring

targets.pathNote: No path, because the site is shutting down.
targets.disqualifier: Plant closure with 56 layoffs announced January 2026

pack.title: Pilot Pack: one high-mix weld family at Southland Steel
pack.baselineLabel: Estimated fully loaded annual cost of one welder (estimate, not a Southland figure)
assumptions: Rule of thumb: US median welder wage of $53,750 (BLS, May 2025, https://www.bls.gov/ooh/production/welders-cutters-solderers-and-brazers.htm) times an assumed 1.3 burden multiplier.
The 1.3 multiplier is a placeholder and should be replaced with Southland's actual labor cost.
Pilot scope is one recurring part family chosen by Southland.
No Path performance figure is assumed; results come only from the pilot's measurements.
pack.successTest: Pilot passes if welds per shift on the chosen part family improve by {pct}% against Southland's measured manual baseline, with parts passing Southland's existing quality inspection.
risks: An incumbent robotic welding vendor may already cover this work.
The 2024 source may not reflect how much of the expansion is now committed.
Customer or code requirements may require weld procedure requalification.
pack.pathToOrder: Agree the part family and baseline, run the pilot, review results with the approvers, then decide on a subscription for cells or on Path Foundry capacity.
